Setup

#Libraries for analysis
library(edgeR)
library(readr)
library(variancePartition)
library(DESeq2)
library(pheatmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)
library(PCAtools)
library(matrixStats)


#Set Directories
setwd("C:/Users/neilm/OneDrive/Desktop/Rprojects/KabukiPaper/New folder/")
res.dir <- "C:/Users/neilm/OneDrive/Desktop/Rprojects/KabukiPaper/New folder/results/Experiment2/KS1/DESeq2/"; if(!dir.exists(res.dir)){dir.create(res.dir, recursive = TRUE)}
#Load and Format Data
#Load in data
metaTable <- read.csv("./input/Experiment2_KS1_metadata.csv")
countsTab <- read.delim("./input/E2KS1_counts.tsv", header = TRUE, row.names = 1)
countsTab<-countsTab[,c(gsub("-", ".",metaTable$File))]
colnames(countsTab) <- metaTable$Sample.Name
#Make counts integers
countsTab[] <- lapply(countsTab, function(x) if (is.numeric(x)) as.integer(x) else x)

#Relevel 
metaTable$Group <- relevel(as.factor(metaTable$Group), "Wildtype")
metaTable$Sex <- as.factor(metaTable$Sex)
metaTable$Date <- as.factor(metaTable$Date)

#Filter low counts - Using 15 for a slightly more stringent than the default recommendation of DESeq2
drop <- rowSums(countsTab < 15) > 3
workingCounts <- countsTab[!drop, ]

#make metaData factors
for (i in 1:ncol(metaTable)) {metaTable[,i] <- as.factor(metaTable[,i])}

#write model
design <- ~Group + Sex + Date

#Create DESeq2 object
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = workingCounts,
                              colData = metaTable,
                              design = design)
#Run DESeq2 model
dds <- DESeq(dds)
## estimating size factors
## estimating dispersions
## gene-wise dispersion estimates
## mean-dispersion relationship
## final dispersion estimates
## fitting model and testing
#stabilize variance - for sample level visualizations
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=FALSE)

Exploratory Vizualization

#Dispersion
#svg(paste(res.dir,"Dispersion.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 7,bg = "white")
plotDispEsts(dds)

#dev.off()
#Distance matrix
colors <- colorRampPalette(brewer.pal(9, "Blues") )(255)
distanceDat<-assay(vsd)
colnames(distanceDat)<- metaTable$Sample.Name
sample_metadata <- data.frame(Group = c("Heterozygous", "Heterozygous", "Heterozygous", "Wildtype", "Wildtype", "Wildtype"),
                              Sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M"),
                              Date = metaTable$Date,
                              row.names = colnames(distanceDat))

ann_colors<-list(Group = c(Heterozygous="#FFD500", Wildtype="#005BBB"),
                 Sex = c("F"="#FFBE6A", "M"="#40B0A6"),
                 Date = c("101025" = "#6A4A3C" , "101325"="#DB1048"),
                 row.names = colnames(distanceDat))

#svg(paste(res.dir,"DistanceMap.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 7, bg = "white") 
pheatmap(cor(distanceDat),
         clustering_distance_rows="euclidean",
         clustering_distance_cols="euclidean",
         cellwidth = 30,
         cellheight = 30,
         annotation_col = sample_metadata,
         annotation_row = sample_metadata,
         annotation_names_col = F,
         annotation_names_row = F,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         labels_row = colnames(distanceDat),
         labels_col = c("","","","","",""),
         col = colors)

#dev.off()
#PCA
pcaData <- plotPCA(vsd, intgroup=c("Group", "Sex"), returnData=TRUE)
colnames(pcaData)<- c("PC1", "PC2","group.1","Group","Sex","Name")
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))

#svg(paste(res.dir,"PCA.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 7, bg = "white") 
ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color=Group, shape=Sex)) +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ",percentVar[1],"% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ",percentVar[2],"% variance")) +
  coord_fixed()+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_color_manual(name = c("Heterozygous", "Wildtype"), values=c("#FFD500","#005BBB"))

#dev.off()
rv <- rowVars(assay(vsd))
select <- order(rv, decreasing=TRUE)[1:500]
p<- pca(assay(vsd)[select,], metadata=colData(vsd), removeVar = 0)

#svg(paste(res.dir,"PCA_scree.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 7, bg = "white") 
screeplot(p)

#dev.off()

#svg(paste(res.dir,"PCA_biplot_1_2.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 11, bg = "white") 
biplot(p, x = "PC1", y = "PC2", colby = 'Group', shape = "Sex", showLoadings = TRUE,labSize = 2, pointSize = 2, sizeLoadingsNames = 2)

#dev.off()

#svg(paste(res.dir,"PCA_pairsplot.svg", sep = ""),width = 16, height = 16, bg = "white") 
pairsplot(p, colby = 'Group', shape = 'Sex', lab = p$yvars, labSize = 3, pointSize = 2)

#dev.off()

#svg(paste(res.dir,"PCA_loadings.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 11, bg = "white") 
plotloadings(p, labSize = 3)

#dev.off()
#Shrunken - Coef name shouldn't need changed but if you encounter an error check valid coef names with resultsNames(dds)
resLFC <- lfcShrink(dds, coef="Group_Heterozygote_vs_Wildtype")
## using 'apeglm' for LFC shrinkage. If used in published research, please cite:
##     Zhu, A., Ibrahim, J.G., Love, M.I. (2018) Heavy-tailed prior distributions for
##     sequence count data: removing the noise and preserving large differences.
##     Bioinformatics. https://doi.org/10.1093/bioinformatics/bty895
#svg(paste(res.dir,"MA_shrunken.svg", sep = ""),width = 8, height = 7,bg = "white") 
plotMA(resLFC, ylim=c(-4, 4), main = "MA Plot of Heterozygote vs Wildtype - Shrunken LFC")

#dev.off()

Call Result Contrasts

#Results and result plotting
#Generate Results
results <- results(dds, name = "Group_Heterozygote_vs_Wildtype")

#Filter Results - I opt for p-adj <= 0.05 and LFC of +/- 0.5 per literature values of LFC in neuron cell culture
res.nona <- na.omit(results)
res.sig = res.nona[res.nona$padj <= 0.05,] ; nrow(res.sig) # for number of DE Genes at p <= 0.05
## [1] 81
res.sig.lfc = res.sig[abs(res.sig$log2FoldChange) > 0.5,]; nrow(res.sig.lfc) # for number of DE Genes at p <= 0.05 & FC =/- 1.5
## [1] 71
#write.csv(res.nona, paste(res.dir,"Results.csv", sep = ""), quote=FALSE)
#write.csv(res.sig, paste(res.dir,"sigResults.csv", sep = ""), quote=FALSE)
#write.csv(res.sig.lfc, paste(res.dir,"sig_fcResults_abs05.csv", sep = ""), quote=FALSE)

Results plotting

#Volcano plot
source("../../../Kabuki Syndrome RNASeq Analysis/OLD/old/fancy_volcano_plot.R") #Custom Volcano plot script prepared by the Patzke lab - I modified it slightly to allow for custom x axis limits and custom titles

#svg(paste(res.dir,"Volcano.svg", sep = ""), width = 8, height = 7,bg = "white") 
fancy_volcano_plot(res.nona, 0.05, 0.5, 2.5, "DEGs in Heterygous vs Wildtype")

#dev.off()
#Heatmap
#data prep
sig_genes <- row.names(res.sig.lfc)
log_sig_counts <- assay(vsd)[sig_genes, ]
colnames(log_sig_counts)<-colData(vsd)$Sample.Name

#svg(paste(res.dir,"DE_Heatmapabs05.svg", sep = ""), width = 8, height = 7, bg = "white") 
pheatmap(na.omit(log_sig_counts),
         cluster_rows=TRUE, cluster_cols=TRUE,   # Clustering
         annotation_col = sample_metadata,
         annotation_names_col = F,
         annotation_colors = ann_colors,
         scale="row",     # Scale by row (gene) to highlight relative expression differences
         show_rownames=F, # Optional: hide gene names for large datasets
         show_colnames = TRUE,
         main="Heatmap of Significant DE Genes")

#dev.off()
